reviewed_runner_controls.apply_scope: Compose up targets UI only, with no dependencies, build or pull; resolved override must change only services.ui.image.
reviewed_runner_controls.runtime_contract: UI image ID, source hash, user, environment, command, healthcheck, mounts, networks, port binding, 512 MiB/0.5 CPU and read-only setting compared against the saved original.
reviewed_runner_controls.regression: One synthetic Streamlit AppTest test, no skips; selects second stream and checks publication/cursor/revision changes through 4 and 5 without network or real tables.
reviewed_runner_controls.live_render: AppTest renders the installed UI against the real API without clicking; compares current stream revision, publication and cursor. This is not a visible browser inspection.
reviewed_runner_controls.preservation: Exact final API/PostgreSQL inventory records; auxiliary records allow changed start times only. All auxiliary health is checked together in the final inventory.
reviewed_runner_controls.aggregate_state: Read-only repeatable-read SQL: eleven table counts plus serving pointer, stream metadata and pipeline targets; before/after digest equality. Not a row-by-row data comparison.
reviewed_runner_controls.recovery: Candidate generation and health rechecked before and after auxiliary restoration. Report indicates no rollback was needed; this run does not exercise physical rollback.

capacity.basis: configured limits, not observed peak memory; auxiliary restoration returns the historical inventory without accrediting sustained concurrent capacity

limits: The private state, inventories, SQL digests, container layers and full logs were not downloaded; remote execution and preservation remain declarations of the audited runner.
The source_state_sha256 identifies the remote antecedent state; its private bytes were not independently rehashed here.
Source and protocol consistency were checked here; no direct SSH inspection or local reproduction of this deployment was performed.
No visible browser inspection/capture is supplied for this deployment; visible_browser_verified remains false.
Rollback image availability was checked, but rollback was not executed in this successful deployment.
No new training, test evaluation, load, latency, OOM/swap or acceptance campaign occurred; no new performance claim follows.
The academic tag, historical failures and T8-B failed result remain unchanged.
preserve: Both UI images by ID, stopped builders, cache and worktrees
Private logs/configuration and all earlier reports/reservations
API/PostgreSQL, volumes, H release, stream data and academic tag
next_step: Use the deployed UI for a separate read-only visual review or presentation. Do not rerun deployment, recovery preparation, restore-only, T8 or training.
